_comment: The freshness surface. ONE file, two readers:
• the build imports it (src/lib/deals.ts) to server-render /status/;
• the browser FETCHES it at runtime and recomputes the staleness verdict
The second reader is the load-bearing one (plan §6.6 / RT-8): if deploy.yml
is what dies, a build-time badge freezes at its last-good value and reports
green forever — it would fail to the same root cause it is supposed to
detect. The browser can tell that a file dated three weeks ago is three
weeks old; a build cannot tell that it never ran.
`data_observed_at` is max(observed_at) across published Lane-1 rows, NOT
last_run_at. 'we fetched recently' is not 'the data changed recently' — a
source serving a frozen snapshot for six months reports perfectly fresh
FIXTURE VALUES. Replaced by the pipeline's real emission at P6.

sources.label: NC OneMap — statewide parcels
sources.note: 11 NC counties. Ashe and Haywood publish parvaltype=Market, which is not comparable to the Assessed counties.

sources.label: NC county tax-foreclosure notices
sources.note: The only Lane-1 source measured against the 48-hour bar.

sources.label: TN property boundaries
sources.note: Boundaries only — no assessed value. The TPAD hop that would carry it is unsettled, so all five TN counties are partial by construction.

sources.label: VA county GIS (per-county)
sources.note: Nine VA counties, each on its own portal; only four responded on the last pass. Augusta sits on VGSI and the 2025 VamaNet migration may have moved it.

sources.label: GA legal-organ / clerk notices
sources.note: Notices only. qPublic blocks automated parcel access for all nine GA counties (E1.1-E1.4), so no parcel record exists behind any GA row.

sources.label: SC Master-in-Equity sale rosters
sources.note: Pickens and Greenville rosters confirmed online. Oconee returned HTTP 500 on probe — that is UNKNOWN, not absent; a quiet Oconee means we cannot see it.

sources.label: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
sources.note: Not yet wired. Every flood_zone in the payload came from the county source, which is why so many are null.
